effect.shortEffect: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.
effect.full: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

french.sv: Le Pokémon enrage s’il a moins de la moitié de ses PV\naprès avoir subi une attaque. Sa Déf. et sa Déf. Spé.\nbaissent, et son Atq., son Atq. Spé. et sa Vit. augmentent.

english.sv: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

japanese.sv: 相手の攻撃で　HPが　半分に　なると 怒りで　防御と　特防が　下がるが 攻撃　特攻　素早さが　上がる。
